Together these make it feel like a designed game page with strong group separation. B is clean and legible with nice spacing, but it looks plainer and more generic. Its title wraps awkwardly into a narrow block, and the group headings stand out less than A's cards. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages use warm off-white serif text on a dark background, readable line lengths, and a clear title-and-date hierarchy.
